content.title: AKU-ISMC's Talha Murat Pursuing a PhD in History
content.summary: AKU-ISMC's student, Talha Murat, has been accepted by Freie Universität Berlin to further his studies.

media.alt: AKU-ISMC's Talha Murat Pursuing a PhD in History

content.text: We warmly congratulate or student Talha Murat on being accepted by Freie Universität Berlin to undertake a PhD in History and pursue his research interests.

Sharing his thoughts on this big achievement and the educational journey, Talha said: "After completing my MA in Turkish Studies, with particular focus on late Ottoman history, at Sabancı University, Turkey, I wanted to broaden my knowledge in Islamic studies and improve my language skills to accomplish my own research aims at a PhD level. Hence, I decided to pursue another MA degree in London. The MA in Muslim Cultures at the Aga Khan University's Institute for the Study of Muslim Civilisations (AKU-ISMC) has perfectly aligned with my academic plans and goals, and the Arabic language programme being offered has increased my motivation with its intensive and helpful courses.

"Indeed, the various courses and seminars I attended here have prepared me fully and provided me with the tools and knowledge needed to move to the next step. Also, at AKU-ISMC, I have been greatly supported by my supervisor Dr Walid Ghali as well as other faculty members. As a result of these immense efforts and support, I have been accepted to study a PhD in History at Freie Universität Berlin where I am planning to conduct a research on late Ottoman Sufism."
